scope: Node VM mocks plus actual ES3 plan/native adapter; no live AE calls or rendered pixel checks.

results.name: ES3 JSON roundtrips Chinese, controls, quotes and Unicode separators without eval
JSON parser rejects execution text, malformed numbers, controls and trailing data
JSON rejects dangerous and duplicate keys at every depth
JSON enforces nesting, value, size and finite-number bounds
JSON stringify supports pretty output, replacers and standard omission rules
Read-only host info and context expose only implemented capabilities and mutate nothing
Protocol, request identity, shape and unsupported mutations are guarded
Create rejects changed context and absence before opening undo or writing
Host validates loaded schema, manifest membership, version and capability requirements
Plan errors and missing required effects stop before any AE writes
Actual native adapter creates, captures and reuses one layer for one stable operation
A changed stable operation cannot create another layer or overwrite the instance
Optional unavailable effects return diagnostics while the native shape survives
Read instance requires stable comp, layer and instance identity and remains read-only
Adapter write failure cleans its own layer and reliably closes undo
Post-create capture failure removes only this operation layer and reads cleanup back
Readback failure on reused instances never deletes the existing layer
Failed cleanup is explicit and undo still closes
Failed adapter cleanup before a result is returned is detected by the dispatcher scan
Reentrant host calls report busy and do not alter the outer operation
